O.outcome_detail: accuracy in subsequent writing

cells.quote: In all cases, focused feedback had a positive effect size in both DCF and ICF. However, it should be noted that more research needs to be done to determine the efficacy of focused ICF because this was only supported by one study (Bitchener & Knoch, 2010). On the other hand, the results for comprehensive feedback demonstrated negative effect sizes for all DCF studies and mixed, with half negative (Lalande, 1982; VanBueningen et al., 2011) and half positive (Truscott & Hsu, 2008; Hartshorn et al., 2010) for comprehensive ICF studies.
cells.note: The synthesis concludes that focused feedback had an overall positive effect, whereas comprehensive feedback had the potential to harm writing over time; the underlying results varied by feedback type and study.
